abstract: Of 21 primary peritoneal, omental, and mesenteric tumors, 14 were cysts and seven were solid. Most of the cysts were omental-mesenteric lymphangiomas; the sole exception was a cystic mesothelioma in a newborn. The solid tumors included three multicentric hamartomas, three sarcomas of undetermined histogenesis, and one immature teratoma. Since cystic lymphangiomas carry a good prognosis following surgical excision, they must be distinguished from cysts of mesothelial origin. Solid hamartomas may simulate malignant tumors because of multicentricity and immature tissue composition. Although peritoneal sarcomas of undetermined histogenesis are apt to be large, composed of primitive cells, and disposed to the development of implants, current treatment modalities may control the disease. One of three treated patients survived for 8 years. A child with a solid immature teratoma without a malignant germ-cell component remains free of disease 5 years after diagnosis. Our review, which represents the combined experience of two children's hospitals over several decades, did not include tumors such as malignant mesothelioma, lipoma, liposarcoma, leiomyoma, mesenchymoma, fibromatosis, and other neoplasms, which may rarely arise in the peritoneum, omentum, and mesentery of children.
abstract_ja: 小児期の原発性腹膜、大網、腸間膜腫瘍21例のうち、14例は嚢胞性、7例は充実性であった。嚢胞の大半は大網・腸間膜リンパ管腫で、例外は新生児の嚢胞性中皮腫1例であった。充実性腫瘍は、多発性過誤腫3例、組織発生不明の肉腫3例、未熟奇形腫1例であった。嚢胞性リンパ管腫は外科的切除後の予後が良好であるため、中皮由来の嚢胞と区別する必要がある。充実性過誤腫は多発性で未熟な組織構成を示すため、悪性腫瘍に類似することがある。組織発生不明の腹膜肉腫は大きく、原始細胞から構成され、播種を起こしやすいが、現在の治療法で制御できる可能性がある。治療を受けた3例のうち1例は8年間生存した。悪性の胚細胞成分を伴わない充実性未熟奇形腫の小児は、診断から5年間無病で経過している。本総説は、数十年にわたる2つの小児病院の経験を集約したものであり、悪性中皮腫、脂肪腫、脂肪肉腫、平滑筋腫、間葉性腫瘍、線維腫症など、腹膜、大網、腸間膜に稀に発生しうる他の腫瘍は含まれていない。
